scope: Two analytic balanced-bit illustrations with known case-specific baselines, ideal window conditional means, fixed d and evolving t; not simulated, fitted or measured QRC/QELM performance.

theorem_context.common_suffix_diameter: supremal declared-output distance between histories sharing the last d inputs
theorem_context.emulation_statement: a growing exact-expectation reset-QELM family universal on each finite window emulates uniformly to arbitrary accuracy exactly when D_d tends to zero
theorem_context.illustration_boundary: The displayed time-dependent two-history gaps are not generic D_d/2 curves. Decay with elapsed time at fixed d does not establish uniform convergence as d grows.
theorem_context.memory_relevance: past inputs must create the state difference and present or future declared outputs must reveal it; full-state forgetting is not required

fading.condition: D_d tends to zero; r_vis < 1 under the spectral theorem assumptions
fading.consequence: arbitrary accuracy as d grows, without a guarantee of exact emulation at a fixed finite d

finite.consequence: output exactly determined by finite context

persistent.condition: D_d >= Delta > 0 for every d; r_vis = 1
persistent.consequence: scalar worst-case error is at least Delta/2

theorem_context.scalar_information_limit: D_d/2 is the optimal worst-case absolute scalar error due to missing history
theorem_context.scope: finite-dimensional QRC with input-continuous channels and fixed finite observable output; the iff statement additionally assumes compact inputs with freely concatenable suffixes and per-window reset-QELM density
theorem_context.status: manuscript interpretation, not a plotted curve or measured property of these toy traces

typography: native 11 pt labels and one shared 10 pt legend at 7.055 inch width; no panel letters
